runtime_callsite_analysis.interpretation: 48 8B 11 loads RDX from [RCX], then FF 52 10 calls through [RDX+0x10], i.e. the vtable slot at +0x10 for the object in RCX.
runtime_callsite_analysis.runtime_correlation: The captured caller return RVA 02C0497A corresponds to the return from this call site when the hooked logical-entry function at NMS.exe RVA 00634BC0 is entered; for that observed event, the call reached the hooked function.
runtime_callsite_analysis.important_distinction: The runtime capture reads owner_pointer+0x10. That is not the same address expression as [vtable+0x10]. Therefore owner+0x10=0 does not establish that the indirect call target was zero or absent.
runtime_callsite_analysis.offline_resolution: The published offline vtable scan found zero static candidates; it did not capture the runtime vtable pointer or prove the slot is absent.
